jei.jaymospowers.found.meteoric_iron_hea: Lies in the heart of the crater a great falling star leaves, seen growing in the night sky before it comes down. Mined with iron or better, it breaks into lumps of meteoric iron.
jei.jaymospowers.found.meteoric_iron: Mined from a great star's iron heart. Each lump melts in a smeltery to two ingots' worth of star metal.
